references.text: Debir is mentioned here as one of the cities Joshua conquered during the southern campaign, highlighting the historical context of the city's capture.
Debir is noted as a city in the hill country that Joshua took from the Anakites, confirming its location in the Judean hills.
Kirjath-Sannah, which is Debir, was mentioned earlier in the same chapter in connection with Caleb's conquest and Othniel, who captured the city.
A parallel account to Joshua 15:15-17 regarding the capture of Debir, formerly called Kirjath-Sepher.
